meaning_detail: Allah is the proper and personal name of God in Islam. It encompasses all of His attributes and is mentioned over 2,000 times in the Quran.
Ar-Rahman refers to the abundant mercy that Allah extends to all of His creation in this world, believer and disbeliever alike.
Ar-Raheem refers to the special mercy Allah reserves for the believers in the Hereafter, a mercy that is deep, lasting, and specific.
Al-Malik is the absolute and true Sovereign over all creation. His dominion is eternal, unlimited, and without any partner.
Al-Quddus is the one who is free from every imperfection, deficiency, and fault. He is pure and sacred beyond all comprehension.
As-Salam is the one from whom all peace originates. He grants peace to His servants and is Himself free from all imperfections.
Al-Mumin is the one who gives security and safety to His believing servants. He testifies to His own oneness and to the truthfulness of His Prophets.
Al-Muhaymin is the one who watches over and protects His creation, overseeing all matters and ensuring nothing is hidden from Him.
Al-Aziz is the Almighty whose might is never overcome. He is rare in His perfection and His strength is incomparable.
Al-Jabbar is the one who compels all of creation to submit to His will. He repairs the broken and is irresistibly dominant.
Al-Mutakabbir is the one who possesses true greatness and majesty. He alone has the right to pride, as all greatness belongs only to Him.
Al-Khaliq is the one who brings things into existence from nothing. He created the heavens, the earth, and everything between them.
Al-Bari is the one who distinguishes things from each other and brings them into being with great precision and perfect design.
Al-Musawwir is the one who gives shape and form to all things. He fashions creation in whatever form He wills.
Al-Ghaffar is the one who repeatedly and completely forgives sins. He covers and conceals the faults of His servants, again and again.
Al-Qahhar is the one who overpowers all of creation. Nothing can escape His dominion and every creature is humbled before Him.
Al-Wahhab is the one who gives abundantly and generously without any expectation of return. His gifts are constant and without limit.
Ar-Razzaq is the one who provides sustenance for all of creation, from the greatest to the smallest. His provision is without limit.
Al-Fattah is the one who opens doors of mercy, provision, and guidance. He resolves all affairs and removes every hardship.
Al-Alim is the one whose knowledge is all-encompassing. He knows the seen and the unseen, the past, present, and future without any limit.
Al-Qabid is the one who withholds and constricts according to His wisdom and will. He tests His servants through restriction as much as through giving.
Al-Basit is the one who extends His mercy and provision generously. He opens the hearts of His believers to faith and expands the soul.
Al-Khafid is the one who lowers and humbles whoever He wills. He brings down the arrogant and the unjust according to His perfect wisdom.
Ar-Rafi is the one who raises and exalts whoever He wills. He elevates believers through faith and righteous deeds to the highest ranks.
Al-Muizz is the one who grants honour and dignity to whoever He wills. True honour only comes from Allah and not from wealth or status.
Al-Mudhill is the one who humiliates and disgraces whoever He wills, particularly the arrogant, the tyrant, and the heedless.
As-Sami is the one who hears every sound and every whisper. Not the most secret of prayers nor the softest of voices escapes His hearing.
Al-Basir is the one who sees all things, the manifest and the hidden. No movement, act, or condition of any being escapes His sight.
Al-Hakam is the ultimate judge whose judgement is perfect and final. He decides between His servants with absolute justice and wisdom.
Al-Adl is the perfectly just one. His justice is pure and complete. He never wrongs anyone by even the weight of an atom.
Al-Latif is the one who is aware of the most subtle and intricate details of creation. He is gentle with His servants in ways they do not perceive.
Al-Khabir is the one who has knowledge of the inner reality of all things, their hidden nature, and their ultimate outcomes.
Al-Halim is the one who does not rush to punish the sinful despite His power to do so. He gives respite out of His mercy and wisdom.
Al-Azim is the one whose greatness and magnificence is beyond all comprehension. His attributes are immeasurably vast and awe-inspiring.
Al-Ghafur is the one who covers the sins of His servants and wipes them away completely, leaving no trace in the records of deeds.
Ash-Shakur is the one who appreciates and rewards even the smallest of good deeds. He multiplies the reward of His grateful servants manifold.
Al-Ali is the one who is high above all creation in His essence, His attributes, and His dominion. No being can ever reach His level.
Al-Kabir is the one who is greater than everything. His greatness is absolute — in power, knowledge, mercy, and every attribute.
Al-Hafiz is the one who preserves all of creation and guards His servants from harm. He records every deed and maintains the order of the universe.
Al-Muqit is the one who provides and oversees the physical and spiritual nourishment of all living beings. He is the sustainer of all.
Al-Hasib is the one who takes precise account of all deeds. He is sufficient for His servants and will reckon with every soul on the Day of Judgement.
Al-Jalil is the one who possesses absolute majesty. His grandeur fills everything and is reflected in every aspect of His creation.
Al-Karim is the one whose generosity has no limit. He gives without being asked, and when asked, He gives more than what is expected.
Ar-Raqib is the one who watches over all things at all times. Nothing escapes His observation — every act, thought, and intention is seen by Him.
Al-Mujib is the one who responds to every sincere call and prayer. He answers His servants when they call upon Him in need and sincerity.
Al-Wasi is the one whose knowledge, mercy, and generosity encompass all of creation. His capacity to give, forgive, and know is boundless.
Al-Hakim is the one whose wisdom is perfect and complete. Everything He decrees and creates has a purpose and wisdom, even if humans do not perceive it.
Al-Wadud is the one who loves His believing servants with a profound, perfect love. He is the source of all true love and affection in the universe.
Al-Majid is the one who is glorious and illustrious, combining both extreme generosity and tremendous honour. His glory is eternal and perfect.
Al-Baith is the one who will resurrect all of creation on the Day of Judgement. He sent the Prophets and will raise all beings from death.
Ash-Shahid is the one who witnesses all things at all times. He is present everywhere and nothing is hidden from His awareness.
Al-Haqq is the absolute truth whose existence is certain and whose attributes are real. He is the only true reality; everything else is contingent.
Al-Wakil is the one in whom all affairs can be entrusted. He takes care of all the needs of those who rely upon Him completely.
Al-Qawi is the one who possesses complete and perfect power. His strength never diminishes and is in no need of any support.
Al-Matin is the one whose strength is firm and inexhaustible. His power cannot be diminished and He is never weakened.
Al-Wali is the close protecting friend of the believers. He supports, guides, and assists those who take Him as their guardian.
Al-Hamid is the one who is deserving of all praise. He is praised for His beautiful names and attributes, His perfect actions, and His eternal glory.
Al-Muhsi is the one who has counted and recorded everything in existence. Not a single leaf falls, nor a grain exists, except that He has counted it.
Al-Mubdi is the one who originated all of creation from nothing, without any prior model or example. He begins all things.
Al-Muid is the one who will restore and bring back all of creation after death. He will resurrect every soul just as He first created it.
Al-Muhyi is the one who gives life to all living things and who will give life to the dead on the Day of Resurrection.
Al-Mumit is the one who causes death to every living being at the appointed time. Life and death are entirely in His hands.
Al-Hayy is the one who is forever living, whose life has no beginning and no end. He never sleeps, never tires, and is eternally alive.
Al-Qayyum is the one who is self-sustaining and upon whom all of creation depends. He subsists by Himself and maintains all of existence.
Al-Wajid is the one who finds whatever He wills whenever He wills. Nothing is lost to Him and He never lacks anything.
Al-Majid is the one of immense nobility and honour. He combines generosity, magnanimity, and supremacy in a way none other can.
Al-Wahid is the one who is unique and singular in His essence, attributes, and actions. There is no one comparable or similar to Him.
Al-Ahad is the one who is absolutely and perfectly unique. He has no partner, no equal, and no rival in any respect whatsoever.
As-Samad is the one who is eternal and self-sufficient. All of creation is in need of Him, yet He needs nothing and no one.
Al-Qadir is the one who has complete power and ability over all things. He does whatever He wills without any obstacle or limitation.
Al-Muqtadir is the one whose power is immense and decisive. He overpowers everything and His decrees are carried out perfectly.
Al-Muqaddim is the one who puts things forward and advances matters. He brings forward whoever He wills in rank and closeness to Him.
Al-Muakhkhir is the one who delays matters according to His wisdom. He defers punishment and puts back those who have transgressed.
Al-Awwal is the one who has no beginning. He existed before all of creation and there was nothing before Him.
Al-Akhir is the one who has no end. He will remain after all of creation has ceased to exist. He is eternal in every direction.
Az-Zahir is the one who is manifest through the signs of His creation. His existence and power are evident in everything around us.
Al-Batin is the one who is hidden from human perception in His essence. He knows all inner secrets and hidden matters.
Al-Wali is the supreme governor and ruler of all existence. He manages and administers all affairs of creation with perfect knowledge and wisdom.
Al-Mutaali is the one who is supremely exalted above all things in His essence and attributes. He is far beyond all that creation can comprehend.
Al-Barr is the source of all goodness and kindness. He is immensely good to His servants and treats them with profound kindness and care.
At-Tawwab is the one who accepts repentance from His servants repeatedly. No matter how many times a servant returns to Him, He accepts their repentance.
Al-Muntaqim is the one who takes retribution against those who persist in oppression and transgression. His vengeance is just and measured.
Al-Afuw is the one who erases sins completely, leaving no trace. His pardon goes beyond forgiveness — it is as though the sin never occurred.
Ar-Rauf is the one who is filled with compassion and tenderness. His compassion reaches even those who transgress when they turn back to Him.
Malik-ul-Mulk is the absolute owner of all sovereignty. He gives power to whom He wills and takes it from whom He wills. All kingdoms belong to Him.
Dhul-Jalali-wal-Ikram is the one who possesses supreme majesty and absolute generosity. He is deserving of the greatest reverence and gratitude.
Al-Muqsit is the one who deals with perfect equity and fairness. He establishes justice among His creation and loves those who act justly.
Al-Jami is the one who will gather all of creation on the Day of Judgement. He also combines and unites all perfect attributes within Himself.
Al-Ghani is the one who is completely self-sufficient and in need of nothing. All of creation depends on Him while He depends on nothing.
Al-Mughni is the one who enriches His servants and makes them free from want. True wealth and independence only come from Him.
Al-Mani is the one who prevents and withholds when His wisdom dictates. He protects His servants by shielding them from harm.
Ad-Darr is the one who allows harm and distress to reach whoever He wills as a test or a punishment, according to His perfect wisdom.
An-Nafi is the one who creates benefit for whoever He wills. All good, profit, and blessing ultimately come from Him alone.
An-Nur is the light of the heavens and the earth. He illuminates the hearts of His servants with faith and guidance.
Al-Hadi is the one who guides whoever He wills to the straight path. He is the source of all guidance for both the heart and the soul.
Al-Badi is the one who creates things in a uniquely beautiful and unprecedented manner. All of creation reflects His originality and creativity.
Al-Baqi is the one who will remain after all of creation has perished. His existence is eternal and will never end.
Al-Warith is the one who inherits everything after the perishing of all creation. All wealth, power, and existence return to Him.
Ar-Rashid is the one who guides all matters to their correct conclusions. He leads to what is right, just, and good through His perfect wisdom.

As-Sabur is the One who is most patient and enduring. He is not hasty in His actions but waits for the proper time. He has all the power to punish those who do wrong, but instead allows time for repentance and return to the right path. His patience and forbearance are perfect and absolute.
